locations.note: The Italian campaign begins with Allied landings and fighting around Salerno.
The Italian campaign builds toward the battle for the fortified monastery and surrounding heights.
The Afrikakorps' offensive opens with an assault on the British at Ajdabiya.
The Afrikakorps fights the British armour in the Cauldron at Gazala.
The Afrikakorps storms Tobruk and seizes its port.
The Afrikakorps' drive into Egypt is stopped at El Alamein.

routes.name: Deutsches Afrikakorps
routes.note: The Afrikakorps rolls east from Ajdabiya through the Gazala Cauldron, takes Tobruk and drives into Egypt until it is stopped at El Alamein.
